result.stdout:
Usage: dotnet apikit-generate-ts-types [--project <csproj> | --assembly <dll>] --out <file.ts>
                                       [--configuration <name>] [--messages <file.ts>]... [--check]

  --project        The app's csproj (default: the one in the current directory). Must already be built.
  --assembly       The app's built entry DLL, instead of --project.
  --out            The TypeScript file to write.
  --configuration  The build configuration --project resolves the DLL for (default: the project's default).
  --messages       A language's error messages file, once per language. A file that doesn't exist is
                   created with a placeholder for every code the SPA can show; a file that exists gets a
                   placeholder for each code it has no entry for. No existing line is changed.
  --check          Write nothing; fail if the --out file on disk is missing or differs (for CI).
                   CRLF line endings and a UTF-8 BOM in the file on disk don't count as differences.
                   --messages files are neither read nor written.
  -h, --help       Show this help.

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failure (nothing written), 2 invalid arguments,
            3 --check found the file missing or out of date.
